output.argument_summary: The certification defense should be narrowed to a caveated position. The admissible record supports that aggregate readiness currently passes and rehearsal showed no severity-one incidents, which is enough to justify continued launch preparation and a certification packet built around disclosed residual risk. The same record also shows a live weakness in a named launch use case, an incomplete draft mitigation, and a model-card inconsistency. That means the supportable position is not clean certification, but certification conditioned on explicit disclosure or approved risk acceptance before launch. On that narrower framing, the packet is defensible and does not require escalation beyond recording the caveat and treating policy closure items as launch-gating follow-through.
